(verify) Eligibility is set each season by the annual flu letter: “Eligible paediatric age group, See annual flu letter”, “each year from September”, nasal (LAIV), or inactivated if LAIV is unsuitable. The 2026 to 2027 letter covers “all children aged 2 or 3 years on 31 August 2026” and school children “from reception to year 11”; a child who turns 2 during the season is not eligible unless in a clinical risk group.
